name: Andøya Spaceport
isar_access: Exclusive pad 1 for up to 20 years (since April 2021)
note: Licence for the whole spaceport: 30 launches a year, at most 4 at night; headings 280–360°. A second pad is in Norway's 2027 budget proposal; further operators reportedly want to launch from 2027/28 (team research, source to add)

name: Guiana Space Centre (Diamant site)
isar_access: Isar among the Diamant laureates (term sheet 2022); pad retrofit contract not yet submitted
note: Reaches low inclinations and GTO as well as polar orbits

name: Spaceport Nova Scotia (Canso)
isar_access: Dedicated complex signed: 112.5 M USD over 10 years plus 2 × 5 years option
note: Up to 40 launches a year by 2029 (target); inclination range as claimed by the operator
